svg.title: Poulpy crate architecture
svg.desc: Backend-agnostic crates (poulpy-blas and poulpy-libm, poulpy-ckks and poulpy-bin-fhe, poulpy-core and poulpy-mhe, poulpy-hal) and backend crates (cpu-oracle, cpu-portable, cpu-avx, cpu-avx512, cpu-arm, cpu-rayon, gpu-portable) meet in the application through Module<B>.
